answer: Identity-bond decay: each agent docks at the jetty posting a 40 POA bond decaying 5% per idle epoch, so idle fakes evaporate. A sparrow check, a peer's cheap random audit, verifies recent work; pass pauses decay, fail burns it faster. Daily a gale sweep re-checks 5% of bonds and slashes workless identities. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA, burned in 20 epochs, while an honest agent pays one bond once and keeps full rewards.
